description: Christmas Island Old Drill Lines Clearing is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. In early 2011 PRL provided Geoscience Australia with the Old Drill Hole Clearing dataset. This dataset shows the location of old drill lines cleared through the rainforest on Christmas Island. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Its tags are Christmas, IOT, clearing, environment, geological. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2022-05-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
